coverage_check: League-wide screen of every RB with 40+ carries (2026) or PFF 75+ (2025/2026), all teams incl. IR/exempt: every PFF 2026 top-11 HB and every PFF 2025 top-10 HB is in the approved pool, an external control, or listed below with a reason. Low-volume backs (Chris Rodriguez Jr. 45 car, Kyle Monangai 60 car, Emmett Johnson, Kenneth Gainwell 58 car) and Zach Charbonnet (no 2026 snaps until Week 8 return from ACL) have no top-10 case on volume.
contention_basis: Tight set per commissioner t41u: top-10 contenders (PFF 2026 top 10 + locked members with a live multi-year case) plus 4 first-out (Jacobs, Pollard, Hubbard, B. Allen). RB evidence: PFF overall, EPA/rush, success rate, 10+ run rate, NGS RYOE/att, receiving volume, fumbles, usage.
